description: Abandoned Mines information is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by data.ontario.ca. The Abandoned Mines information system (AMIS) is a database containing information on known abandoned mine sites and mine hazard features located on both Crown and privately held lands within the province of Ontario. This includes sites that are abandoned, may possibly be in production or may be covered by a closure plan. Coverage: Ontario. Its tags are Abandoned Mine, Economy and Business, Environment and Natural Resources, Environment and energy, Environnement et richesses naturelles. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, WEB. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is King's Printer for Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
